title: 品牌在悬浮平台上
prompt: A highly detailed cinematic advertisement scene featuring [TYPE OF ALCOHOL, BRAND], standing on a surreal floating platform that visually embodies its spirit. The platform is made of materials that represent the drink’s essence (e.g. sparkling crystals for champagne, rich dark wood for whiskey, frosted ice for vodka), with dramatic reflections and melting details dripping into a calm reflective water surface. A matching glass is filled with the drink, featuring artistic textures (ice, gems, swirling liquid). Soft, colorful sunset sky with dramatic clouds in the background, high-end luxury aesthetic, photorealistic, macro details, dreamy glow, premium product photography.
description: 使用 Nano Banana Pro，为酒精品牌打造超现实悬浮平台广告场景，通过戏剧性反射和材质象征，生动展现产品精髓，适用于品牌宣传和产品摄影。
